are_you_ok.title: CPS Energy wraps up days-long power restoration efforts after severe weather in San Antonio
are_you_ok.summary: Severe storms cut power to more than 250,000 customers of CPS Energy, the city-owned electric and gas utility, across San Antonio. In the first days after, the city ran six resilience hubs and the San Antonio Food Bank held three food distribution events for residents still in the dark, some sitting in homes in the low 90s. Outages fell from more than 100,000 to under 2,000 and then to the hundreds as crews worked through the week, and CPS Energy closed out the restoration effort saying power was back for all 250,000-plus customers affected.
are_you_ok.description: CPS Energy says it has restored power to the over 250,000 customers affected by Friday's severe storms in San Antonio.
